production.note: US model years 2020 and 2022-2025; there was no 2021 model. First: 'The New 2020 BMW M8 Coupe and Convertible' (June 2019), "Pricing for the new 2020 M8 Coupe is $133,000 ... and $146,000 for the M8 Competition Coupe." Gap: BMW NA's MY2021 update says "The M8 Coupe and Convertible will not be imported for MY21, only the M8 GC." (bmw-us-my2021-updates). Return: Autoblog (Zac Palmer, 4 Aug 2021) says the Coupe and Convertible "didn't see a 2021 model year" and that for 2022 "all M8s will be Competition models" (autoblog-2022-m8-return). Last: bmwblog (Horatiu Boeriu, 22 Dec 2024): M8 Coupe production "will stop production in early 2025" and "There will be no Model Year 2026 version" (bmwblog-m8-coupe-end); Kelley Blue Book's 2025 M8 Competition Coupe page says "The 2-door M8 Competition Coupe is being discontinued" (kbb-2025-m8-competition-coupe). A non-Competition M8 Coupe (600 hp) was sold in the US for model year 2020 only; it is not part of this record.

body.note: Column 'M8 Competition Coupe'. The Convertible (F91) and four-door Gran Coupe (F93) have their own chassis codes and are not part of this record. The owner's rule (3 October 2026) allows splitting bodies when weights differ markedly; the M8 Competition Convertible (F91) is 4,560 lb against the coupe's 4,295 lb.

configuration.note: 4.4-liter V8 with the two turbochargers inside the V

aspiration.note: Two turbochargers positioned within the V of the engine

fuel.note: Inferred from the release's description of the twin-turbo gasoline V8; no hybrid system is described.

drivetrain.note: 'Drive type: AWD, AWD, AWD, AWD'; 'M xDrive all-wheel drive system'.

transmission.note: Eight-speed M Steptronic with Drivelogic (torque-converter automatic)

powerHp.note: Quote: "Engine power | hp | 600 | 617 | 600 | 617" (M8 Coupe | M8 Competition Coupe | M8 Convertible | M8 Competition Convertible); summary bullet: "617 hp M8 Competition Coupe and Competition Convertible". Unchanged later: BMW NA's 2023 M8 Competition release gives "617 hp at 6,000 rpm" (bmw-us-2023-m8-competition).

weightLb.note: Single configuration (automatic coupe), 2020 model. Quote: "Curb weight | lbs. | 4,295 | 4,295 | 4,560 | 4,560" (M8 Coupe | M8 Competition Coupe | M8 Convertible | M8 Competition Convertible).
